issues.title: Missing allowDangerouslySkipPermissions flag
issues.description: bypassPermissions mode requires allowDangerouslySkipPermissions: true per SDK contract
issues.impact: SDK contract violation, potential runtime failure in future SDK versions

issues.title: permissionMode type not derived from constant + missing SDK modes
issues.description: Hardcoded string union instead of derived type. Missing delegate and dontAsk modes from SDK.
issues.impact: DRY violation, callers can't use all SDK modes

issues.title: Model fallback skips MODEL_MAP validation
issues.description: env.CLAUDE_MODEL used directly without MODEL_MAP mapping when options.model not provided
issues.impact: Invalid model string reaches SDK if env misconfigured

issues.title: Incomplete test coverage for SDK integration
issues.description: Tests only verify function existence, not parameter passing or SDK invocation

issues.title: Missing validation for numeric parameters
issues.description: maxTurns and maxBudgetUsd accept negative, NaN, or Infinity without validation
issues.impact: Confusing SDK errors instead of clear validation messages

issues.title: DEFAULT_TOOLS not sealed with as const
issues.description: Exported as mutable array, should use as const for immutability

issues.title: Missing prompt validation
issues.description: Empty or whitespace-only prompts passed directly to SDK

issues.title: Undocumented bypassPermissions default
issues.description: Default to bypassPermissions is intentional but lacks JSDoc explaining security rationale
